newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares drift in low demand.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares drift in low demand.

text.p: The Botswana Stock Exchange continued to drift aimlessy on insignificant demand last week, exchange officials said.

Engen was the only stock bid up, adding 10 thebe to close at 435. Trading at previous levels were Barclays at 390 thebe, First National at 475, Inco at 75, Metsef at 645, Standard Chartered at 370 and Sechaba at 255.
Untraded were Botswana Insurance, Kgolo ya Sechaba, Sefalana, Pep, and Realestate Development.
Turnover was higher than the previous week, with 147,290 (59,815) shares changing hands for value Pula 389,133 (Pula 226,498).
The index gained 0.24 points to close at 347.79.
